Acl.description: Represents the set of ACLs for a given Kafka Resource Pattern, which consists of resource_type, resource_name and pattern_type.

A terminal 'T' character in the etag indicates that the AclEntries were truncated; more entries for the Acl exist on the Kafka Cluster, but can't be returned in the Acl due to repeated field limits.

TaskRetryPolicy.description: Task Retry Policy is implemented on a best-effort basis. The default policy retries tasks with a minimum_backoff of 60 seconds, and a maximum_backoff of 12 hours.
